cost_note: Built to stay inside the configured Google Places quota, Gemini free tier, GitHub Actions, and GitHub Pages. Budget alerts remain the final safety net.

roadmap.title: Browser-rendered source fallback
roadmap.detail: Render JavaScript-heavy restaurant pages only when the lightweight crawler cannot recover useful text.

roadmap.title: Image and PDF specials
roadmap.detail: Use local OCR first, then Gemini only for difficult menu images that appear to contain offers.

roadmap.title: Extraction quality
roadmap.detail: Keep tightening day, time, price, and evidence matching while suppressing ordinary menu items.

roadmap.title: Report follow-through
roadmap.detail: Structured reports are checked and labeled automatically. Trusted reports start a source refresh; evidence-backed fixes stay traceable in GitHub.

roadmap.title: Restaurant logos
roadmap.detail: Cache logos from official sites carefully without slowing or cluttering the deal list.

roadmap.title: Installable offline app
roadmap.detail: Cache the latest feed for faster repeat visits and limited offline browsing.
